title: Fidelity-gated traffic abridger with deterministic replay and rollback orchestration
author: Sana Patel
release_notes: Introduces a fidelity-gated traffic abridger that enables deterministic replay for shadow traffic and an automatic rollback orchestration path when fidelity or smoke metrics regress.
description:
Summary: This PR adds a fidelity-gated traffic abridger and deterministic replay integration into the rollout runtime. Motivation: we've observed noisy shadow-to-canary promotions where sporadic low-fidelity responses caused noisy metric spikes and unnecessary rollbacks. The new component reduces sampling variance by gating promotion traffic based on fidelity heuristics and supporting deterministic replay of failing traces to accelerate triage and automatic rollback decisions.

What changed (high level):
- rollout/abridger: new fidelity gate that evaluates model output quality signals and schedules gradual traffic folds instead of atomic promotions.
- replay/recorder: deterministic request/response snapshotting for shadow traffic with idempotent replay hooks.
- orchestration/rollback: automated rollback orchestration that consumes replayed traces and fidelity deltas to decide rollback windows and credits.
- api: a lightweight control API to mark forced-promote/force-hold and to fetch replay artifacts for diagnostics.
- tests: unit + integration harness replicating spike scenarios and synthetic regressions.

Checklist: [x] design doc linked (Linear ENG-1149) [x] unit tests covering gate thresholds and backoff [x] integration test for replay path [x] e2e smoke harness updated [x] metrics and tracing added [x] feature-flagged (off by default)

Commits (summary):
- 1a2f3d4: initial fidelity-gate interface and gating policy types
- 2b3c4d5: implement abridger scheduler and gradual-fold algorithm
- 3c4d5e6: deterministic recorder for shadow traffic + replay runner
- 4d5e6f7: rollback orchestration consumer + playbook wiring
- 5e6f7g8: tests, docs, metrics, and lint fixes

Files touched (representative):
- rollout/abridger/abridger.go (core gate + scheduler)
- rollout/abridger/policy.go (gate heuristics and thresholds)
- replay/recorder/recorder.go (snapshot + storage adapter)
- replay/runner/replay_runner.go (deterministic replay executor)
- orchestration/rollback/consumer.go (automated rollback state machine)
- api/internal/rollout_control.go (control endpoints)
- observability/metrics/rollout_metrics.yaml (new metrics)
- tests/integration/abridger_smoke_test.go

Small snippet (abridger policy evaluation):
func EvaluateFidelity(ctx context.Context, out ModelOutput, snapshot FidelitySnapshot) bool {
    // returns true if fidelity is sufficient to allow gradual promotion
    score := fidelityScore(out, snapshot)
    return score >= snapshot.Config.Threshold
}

Design notes:
- Gate decisions combine output-level heuristics (semantic similarity, token divergence) and traffic-level signals (error rate, latency, cohort drift).
- Deterministic replay stores request + deterministic RNG seeds and model KV cache pointers to reproduce the same sequence across model variants. Replay artifacts are TTL'd and encrypted.
- Rollback orchestration uses a credit-based window: transient minor regressions consume credits, sustained regressions trigger automated rollback and quarantine of the variant. Credits are replenished by stabilizing metrics.

Review conversation (selected):
- Marco Ruiz (review): "Nice separation between gate and scheduler. A couple of items: 1) can we make the replay TTL configurable per-tenant? 2) ensure the recorder doesn't leak PII—suggest adding redaction hooks."
- Sana (author): "Added tenant-level TTL and a pluggable redactor interface. PTAL at the replay adapter tests where I validate redaction."
- Liang Zhou (review): "Integration tests are robust; however the default gate threshold looks aggressive for small cohorts. Suggest a conservative default and clear docs for tuning."
- Sana: "Lowered default threshold and added a tuning section to rollout docs with practical examples."
- Ava Thompson: "Approvals after addressing test flakiness — ran e2e 3x locally."

CI: Initial CI run failed on lint (package docs) and a flaky integration test. Lint fix and test stabilization pushed in 5e6f7g8; CI re-run passed all checks (unit, integration, e2e smoke).

Compatibility and rollout plan:
- Feature-flagged via rollout.flags.fidelity_abridger (default OFF).
- Gradual rollout to Dedicated customers: opt-in via console; default for new Private installs is OFF.
- Observability: added metrics rollout.fidelity_score, replay.artifact_count, rollback.trigger_count; dashboards patched.

Post-merge tasks:
- Add a short runbook entry for analyzing replay artifacts and interpreting fidelity_score (ENG-1149 follow-up).
- Schedule a canary promotion test against a seeded low-cohort traffic stream.

Merge: Squash merge on 2026-02-18 after approvals from Marco and Ava. Merge note: "Adds fidelity-gated abridger, deterministic replay, and automated rollback orchestration (ENG-1149). Feature flagged off by default."

Notes for oncall: if rollback.trigger_count spikes during rollout, run the replay retrieval tool (api/internal/rollout_control#fetch_replay) and inspect redacted artifacts before escalating.
